blocks.text: North Korea’s latest threats may be a ploy to undermine South Korea’s border security operations and cement the division of the Korean Peninsula into two permanently separate states, experts said Tuesday, as Seoul’s top military officer warned of a firm response to any further provocations by Pyongyang. Kim Yo-jong, North Korean leader Kim Jong-un’s sister, on Monday, accused Seoul of escalating tensions near the Military Demarcation Line, describing the situation as “very unstable” and threatening to reinforce tactical strike capabilities and resume loudspeaker broadcasts directed at the South.
